short: (1) The current that flows through the dielectric of a capacitor when voltage is applied across the capacitor plates.
long: (1) The current that flows through the dielectric of a capacitor when voltage is applied across the capacitor plates. (2) The very small current that flows when a diode is reverse-biased.
